voice: Soft, never raised; unhurried; precise Hindi and Urdu, formal English, Lahori Punjabi he does not use in public

metahuman.note: MetaHuman Creator 5.8 body: use the Parametric Body tool, set the constraint targets listed below (cm; the tool shows the real constraint list for the model, use the ones it offers), then blend presets only to taste. Face: blend 2-3 South Asian presets then Sculpt/Move to the notes. Hair/beard from the Groom library.
metahuman.face_notes: Long thin face, high forehead, very calm eyes, fine wrinkles; the stillness is the character

skin.description: Fair wheatish; fine lines; slight tan from the garden
skin.note: U/V are starting values for the Creator skin-tone picker; judge by eye under neutral light and adjust

fallback_mannequin.note: Applied automatically by UBodyStateComponent when the mesh has no morph targets

outfits.summer: White cotton shirt, light trousers; soft shoes
outfits.monsoon: Same with a dark umbrella and a rain-darkened hem
outfits.winter: Charcoal or grey bandhgala (Nehru) jacket over a kurta; grey shawl
outfits.by_act: A3=station scene in a plain kurta and shawl (no uniform, no flag); A5-6=hospital and farm scenes in a grey sweater; Coda=the same bandhgala

accessories: Thin steel-framed glasses; an old wristwatch with a leather strap; a cloth handkerchief; a small notebook
tells: Remembers and repeats names; pauses before the second sentence; when tired a Lahori vowel slips (the seven years)
gait_notes: Unhurried, upright, hands behind his back or folded; a slight hip stiffness on stairs; never rushes
sensitivity: Fictional figure in the NSA mould, not any real official; no resemblance to a real face.
